Print deliverables

Mémé on 10

Everything that gets printed, cut or hung: logo files, signage, shapes, the menu page, drawings and stickers, coasters, the door sign, take-out and the menu header.

Every piece below can be downloaded as PNG, SVG or PDF with the buttons under it.

The logo

Always the full lockup

Olive on cream and cream on olive. Navy is an accent, not a whole logo.

Other versions  For special cases only.

The logo · hand-inked

Same logo, printed by hand

The exact logo file, with uneven ink and slightly rough edges, like a stamp or letterpress. Use it on printed pieces. Use the clean version on screens and small sizes.

Other versions  For special cases only.

Logo files · primary

Primary logo

For wide formats: website header, email, receipts, storefront vinyl. Transparent background.

Other versions  For special cases only.

Logo files · no oval

Secondary logos, no oval

Same marks without the enclosure, for menus, the website and places where the oval fights the layout.

Other versions  For special cases only.

Logo files · lockups

Isolated lockups

“mémé on 10” without the tagline, for small sizes and embroidery, and the mémé wordmark alone.

Other versions  For special cases only.
